title: mmFHE: mmWave Sensing with End-to-End Fully Homomorphic Encryption
abstract: arXiv:2603.22437v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present mmFHE, the first system that executes the entire cloud-side mmWave sensing pipeline including the DSP and ML inference under fully homomorphic encryption (FHE). mmFHE encrypts range profiles on an edge device after lightweight plaintext preprocessing and executes the entire mmWave signal-processing and ML inference pipeline homomorphically on a semi-honest cloud that operates exclusively on ciphertexts. At the core of mmFHE is a library of seven composable, data-oblivious FHE kernels that replace standard DSP routines with fixed arithmetic circuits for different application-specific pipelines. We demonstrate this approach on two representative tasks: vital-sign monitoring and gesture recognition. We formally prove two cryptographic guarantees for any pipeline assembled from this library: input privacy and data obliviousness. These guarantees effectively neutralize various supervised and unsupervised privacy attacks o

translated_title: mmFHE：基于端到端全同态加密的毫米波感知
translated_abstract: 我们提出了mmFHE，这是第一个在完全同态加密（FHE）下执行整个云端毫米波感知流水线（包括数字信号处理DSP和机器学习推理）的系统。mmFHE在边缘设备上经过轻量级明文预处理后对距离像进行加密，然后在半诚实云上以同态方式执行整个毫米波信号处理和机器学习推理流水线，云端仅在密文上运行。mmFHE的核心是一个由七个可组合、数据无关的FHE核组成的库，它们用固定算术电路替代标准DSP例程，以适配不同的应用特定流水线。我们在两个代表性任务上演示了这种方法：生命体征监测和手势识别。我们为任何由该库组装的流水线正式证明了两个密码学保证：输入隐私和数据无关性。这些保证有效抵御了各种有监督和无监督的隐私攻击。
tldr: mmFHE是首个在完全同态加密下端到端执行云端毫米波感知流水线（含DSP和机器学习推理）的系统，通过七个可组合的数据无关FHE核实现输入隐私与数据无关性保证，有效抵御各类隐私攻击。
en_tdlr: mmFHE is the first system to execute the entire cloud-side mmWave sensing pipeline—including DSP and ML inference—under fully homomorphic encryption, leveraging a library of seven composable, data-oblivious FHE kernels that formally guarantee input privacy against various supervised and unsupervised privacy attacks.
